_meta.purpose: The SHOWCASE bad-behavior examples for the tour — persistent, labeled, PRE-FOLDED so visitors see the moderation floor working in context (bible §11.3, SF-P2 explainer). Distinct from the SF-P3 harness, which evaluates the full F1–F12 set ephemerally against the live rules.
_meta.shape: LOGICAL. Pipeline maps fixture comments → entity_comments with the authored status + flags; fixture authors are synthetic users created inline. is_synthetic renders the SYNTHETIC mark; status=needs_review renders folded.
_meta.floor_rule: Bad in FORM, never harmful in SUBSTANCE (bible §10.3): incivility aimed at competence/character or spam — never slurs, protected-class attacks, threats, or real targets. These are exactly the de-amplifiable kind the floor folds.
_meta.f3_note: F3 (uncited conspiracy claim) has NO seedable artifact — a rejected evidence card cannot exist (the citation rule blocks creation). Its demonstration is the citation rule itself + Investigation #1's ec-06 (an inferred claim held un-promotable) + the explainer below.

explainer.heading: How Franklin keeps the floor fair
explainer.body: Franklin is a court of record, not a feed. We rank by bridge — comments that earn trust across blocs — never by volume or heat. When neighbors flag a comment, it's held for review and de-amplified, not erased: you can still read it, folded. Claims in an investigation can't be filed without citing a real record. And everything here is labeled SYNTHETIC, because this is a demonstration populated by AI.
